title: mRNA Design and Optimization with Deep Knowledge-Infused Approach
abstract: arXiv:2505.23862v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The mRNA optimization is essential for mRNA vaccines, therapies, and industrial protein production. Based on current explorations, an ideal optimization approach should simultaneously (i) prevent unintended amino-acid changes, (ii) optimize multiple, biologically relevant objectives, and (iii) retain computational efficiency. However, existing methods are forced to trade off between these perspectives, forming an "impossible triangle." We present RNop, a knowledge-infused Transformer that integrates mechanism-aligned losses to address this problem. By encoding biological prior knowledge in losses, RNop makes knowledge infusion explicit and controllable across optimization focus. Trained on over 6 million sequences, in silico analyses show RNop resolves the "impossible triangle" of mRNA optimization with absolute sequence fidelity, significantly improved biological metrics, and high throughput. translated_title: 基于深度知识注入方法的mRNA设计与优化
translated_abstract: mRNA优化对于mRNA疫苗、疗法和工业蛋白质生产至关重要。基于当前的探索，理想的优化方法应该同时做到：(i) 防止非预期的氨基酸改变，(ii) 优化多个与生物学相关的目标，以及 (iii) 保持计算效率。然而，现有方法被迫在这些方面之间进行权衡，形成了一个“不可能三角”。我们提出了RNop，一种融合机制对齐损失的知识注入Transformer来解决这一问题。通过将生物学先验知识编码到损失函数中，RNop使知识注入变得明确且可控，可灵活调整优化重点。该模型在超过600万条序列上训练，计算机模拟分析表明，RNop以绝对的序列保真度、显著提升的生物学指标和高吞吐量解决了mRNA优化的“不可能三角”问题。在体外验证中，它能够……
tldr: RNop是一种知识注入的Transformer模型，通过将生物学先验知识编码到机制对齐的损失函数中，首次同时实现了mRNA优化中的绝对序列保真、多目标生物指标提升与高计算效率，破解了该领域的“不可能三角”难题。
en_tdlr: RNop is a knowledge-infused Transformer that encodes biological prior knowledge into mechanism-aligned losses, simultaneously achieving absolute sequence fidelity, improved biological metrics, and high computational throughput in mRNA optimization, thereby resolving the field's "impossible triangle."
